title: Don't Guess, Just Ask: Evaluating Interactive Requirement Clarification for Repository-Level Software Development
title_zh: 不要猜测，直接提问：评估仓库级软件开发中的交互式需求澄清方法

paragraphs.en: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), software development is gradually moving toward a paradigm where users describe what they want and LLMs carry out the implementation. As LLMs’ implementation capabilities improve, an increasingly critical bottleneck emerges: whether LLMs truly understand what users want. In practice, users often begin with vague intent, leaving many important requirements to be progressively clarified through interaction. This is especially consequential in repository-level development, where an incorrect LLM’s guess about user intent can propagate through subsequent development phases, causing costly rework in long-horizon tasks. However, existing repository-level code generation benchmarks typically evaluate code generation directly from either complete specifications or underspecified requests, overlooking the importance of pre-coding requirement clarification. Meanwhile, prior requirement clarification studies mainly focus on function-level tasks, failing to reflect the complexity of real-world software development scenarios. Thus, it remains unclear how well LLMs can turn vague user intent into clear requirements through interactive clarification and how such clarification capability affects subsequent code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，软件开发正逐渐转向一种范式：用户描述其需求，而 LLM 则负责具体实现。 随着 LLM 的实现能力不断提升，一个日益关键的瓶颈浮现出来：LLM 是否真正理解用户的需求。 在实践中，用户通常从模糊的意图开始，许多重要需求需要通过交互逐步明确。 这在仓库级开发中尤为关键，因为 LLM 对用户意图的错误推测可能会延续到后续的开发阶段，导致长期任务中出现代价高昂的返工。 然而，现有的仓库级代码生成基准测试通常直接从完整规范或描述不完整的需求出发评估代码生成效果，忽视了编码前明确需求的重要性。 同时，以往的需求澄清研究主要聚焦于函数级任务，未能反映真实软件开发场景的复杂性。 因此，LLM 能否通过交互式澄清将模糊的用户意图转化为清晰的需求，以及这种澄清能力如何影响后续代码生成，目前仍不清楚。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce ReqClarifyBench , an interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development. ReqClarifyBench contains 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development. Each task includes a high-level vague user intent, a detailed requirement document validated by human, and the corresponding code evaluation artifacts. To better simulate a realistic interactive clarification process, we further employ LLM-based user simulators with diverse personas derived from real-world conversation history. Based on ReqClarifyBench , we conduct a systematic empirical study. Specifically, we evaluate six LLMs’ requirement clarification capabilities from two complementary perspectives: how effectively they ask clarification questions and the quality of the generated requirement documents. The experimental results demonstrate that stronger clarification effectiveness does not necessarily translate into higher requirement document quality, and that LLMs exhibit substantial performance variations across different user personas. We also find that, compared with standalone LLMs, coding-agent harnesses do not further improve the ability to transform vague user intent into requirement documents. Based on these findings, we provide valuable insights for building LLM-based end-to-end software development systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 ReqClarifyBench——一个用于仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准。 ReqClarifyBench 包含 341 项任务，涵盖游戏、迷你应用和网页开发领域。 每项任务都包括一个高层次的模糊用户意图、一份经过人类验证的详细需求文档，以及相应的代码评估产物。 为了更好地模拟真实的交互式澄清过程，我们还采用了基于 LLM 的用户模拟器，这些模拟器具有源自真实对话历史的不同角色设定。 基于 ReqClarifyBench，我们开展了一项系统性的实证研究。 具体而言，我们从两个互补的视角评估了六种 LLM 的需求澄清能力：它们提出澄清问题的有效性，以及所生成需求文档的质量。 实验结果表明，更强的澄清效果并不必然意味着更高的需求文档质量，并且 LLM 在不同用户角色设定下的表现存在显著差异。 我们还发现，与独立的 LLM 相比，编码智能体工具链并未进一步提升将模糊用户意图转化为需求文档的能力。 基于这些发现，我们为构建基于 LLM 的端到端软件开发系统提供了有价值的见解。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable of handling long-horizon software development tasks ( Deng et al., 2026a ; Deng et al., 2026b ) . This progress is paving the way for a requirement-driven development paradigm, where users describe what they want and LLMs carry out the long-horizon implementation ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Wei, 2024 ; Ullrich et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . However, the success of this paradigm depends on clear and complete requirements, while real-world users often begin with vague descriptions of their intents that need to be progressively clarified through further interactions ( Ferrari et al., 2022 ; Vijayvargiya et al., 2026 ) . Neglecting requirement clarification may lead to incorrect assumptions, which will propagate to subsequent design, implementation, and testing phases, causing the implementation to drift away from the user’s intent and increasing the need for human oversight and rework in long-horizon tasks ( Chari and Agrawal, 2018 ; Frattini et al., 2023 ) .

When a request is underspecified, LLMs may make a guess about what the user wants without asking for clarification, wasting time and tokens without producing a satisfactory outcome. Although LLMs’ implementation capabilities continue to improve, as reflected in rising benchmark scores ( Deng et al., 2026b ; Deng et al., 2026a ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) , they may still spend substantial time and tokens acting on a misunderstanding of the user’s request. paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks ( zhang et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) have demonstrated progress in the end-to-end transformation of Natural Language Requirements (NLRs) into repository-level code. However, they largely overlook the importance of requirement clarification in this process, evaluating code generation from either well-specified requirement documents or vague user requests without multi-turn requirement clarification. Meanwhile, the Requirements Engineering (RE) community has explored LLM-based requirement clarification. Nevertheless, existing studies ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Mu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) mainly focus on function-level tasks, failing to reflect the complexity of real-world software projects. Moreover, these studies often employ simulated users that follow a fixed interaction pattern, failing to capture diverse real-user behaviors ( Jin et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准研究（zhang et al., 2026；Luo et al., 2026b；Lu et al., 2026；Ding et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2026b）已经证明了在将自然语言需求（NLRs）端到端地转化为仓库级代码方面取得了进展。 然而，这些研究在很大程度上忽视了该过程中需求澄清的重要性，它们要么基于明确定义的需求文档，要么基于模糊的用户请求进行代码生成评估，而并未涉及多轮次的需求澄清过程。 与此同时，需求工程（RE）领域已经探索了基于大语言模型的需求澄清方法。 尽管如此，现有的研究（Fang et al., 2026；Mu et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2026）主要集中在功能级任务上，未能反映真实世界软件项目的复杂性。 此外，这些研究通常采用遵循固定交互模式的模拟用户，因而无法捕捉到真实用户的多样化行为（Jin et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we introduce ReqClarifyBench , an interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development. ReqClarifyBench aims to evaluate LLMs’ ability to transform vague user intents into clear requirement documents through multi-turn requirement clarification. ReqClarifyBench contains 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development. It is constructed through a semi-automated pipeline. Each task includes a high-level vague user intent, a detailed requirement document validated by humans, and the corresponding code evaluation artifacts. To support realistic interactions, we derive three representative user personas from SWE-chat ( Baumann et al., 2026 ) , a large-scale dataset of multi-turn conversations between software developers and coding agents. These personas are used to guide the LLM-based user simulator throughout the clarification process. In addition, we introduce three new metrics to assess LLMs’ requirement clarification capabilities from two perspectives: how effectively LLMs ask clarification questions and the quality of the generated requirement documents.

sents.zh: 此外，我们还引入了三项新指标，从两个角度评估大型语言模型的需求澄清能力：LLM 提出澄清问题的有效性，以及所生成需求文档的质量。

paragraphs.en: Based on ReqClarifyBench , we conduct a systematic empirical study focusing on the following four dimensions. (1) Overall performance across LLMs and user personas. The results show that stronger clarification effectiveness does not necessarily lead to higher requirement document quality, and that user interaction styles can substantially affect model performance. (2) LLMs’ clarification behavior. The results reveal three distinct interaction patterns: clarification with expert users is typically short and efficient, interactions with vague users are sustained but low-yield, and new requirement information often emerges in later rounds when users change their requirements. (3) The impact of clarification on requirement document quality and code generation. Our experiments show that interactive clarification consistently improves requirement document quality, with particularly substantial gains in fine-grained requirement alignment, and further benefits subsequent implementation. (4) Effect of coding-agent harness. We compare standalone LLMs with the same LLMs running within coding-agent harnesses. The results show that coding-agent harnesses improve clarification effectiveness but do not further enhance the quality of derived requirement documents. Overall, these findings suggest that requirement clarification goes beyond simply asking more questions. Requirement clarification requires the evaluated LLM to elicit key information, understand and integrate requirements expressed during multi-turn interaction, and adapt its clarification strategy to different user personas. These capabilities together determine whether an LLM can transform a vague user intent into reliable software requirements, supporting subsequent code generation.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based code generation has advanced from function-level programming to end-to-end repository-level software engineering ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2026a ) . Several approaches are proposed to facilitate this progress. MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) employs agents with different roles to collaboratively perform requirement analysis, system design, and code implementation. ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) coordinates role-playing agents through communication across the design, coding, and testing stages. RPG ( Luo et al., 2026a ) uses a structured Repository Planning Graph to support planning and repository generation. However, these approaches typically treat the initial user intent as a fixed task objective. Although requirement analysis is included, missing information is generally inferred by LLMs rather than clarified through interaction with the user. Consequently, the resulting software may deviate from the user’s actual intent. The conversational capabilities of LLMs enable them to proactively ask clarification questions and construct a clear and complete requirement document based on user feedback. Nevertheless, interactive requirement clarification remains underexplored in repository-level software development. In this paper, we introduce ReqClarifyBench and conduct an empirical study to investigate the role of requirement clarification in repository-level software development.

paragraphs.en: Despite the growing task complexity, these benchmarks typically evaluate code generation from fixed requirements. In real-world development, however, users often begin with a vague intent, leaving many important requirements to be progressively clarified through interactions. Benchmarks that provide complete and clear descriptions ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) overlook the requirement clarification process, failing to reflect real-world development scenarios. Conversely, benchmarks using vague requests as inputs ( Lu et al., 2026 ; zhang et al., 2026 ) require LLMs to infer missing information without user feedback, making it difficult to determine whether failures stem from limited code generation capabilities or requirement misunderstandings. This highlights the need to systematically evaluate LLMs’ ability to transform vague and incomplete user intents into clear requirement documents through interactions.

paragraphs.en: Requirement clarification is a central problem in Requirements Engineering (RE) ( Brooks, 1987 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . It typically involves iterative interaction with stakeholders to clarify their goals, constraints, and unstated requirements ( Fischbach et al., 2021 ) . Recent studies have explored requirement clarification for LLM-based code generation from different perspectives. ClarifyGPT ( Mu et al., 2024 ) detects ambiguous requirements, generates targeted clarification questions, and refines the requirements based on user responses before generating code. ClarifyCoder ( Wu et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes LLMs to recognize underspecified problems and request missing information. ClarifyCodeBench ( Fang et al., 2026 ) introduces an interactive benchmark containing underspecified programming problems, annotated clarification questions and answers, and executable test cases. However, these studies primarily focus on simple function-level problems, failing to reflect real-world complex software development. paragraphs.en: In this section, we introduce ReqClarifyBench , the first interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development, aiming to evaluate LLMs’ ability to transform vague user intents into clear requirement documents through multi-turn interaction. We first describe the construction procedure and then present the characteristics of ReqClarifyBench .

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , ReqClarifyBench is constructed through a semi-automated human-in-the-loop pipeline, which consists of three stages: source benchmark curation, requirement reconstruction and intent abstraction, and human validation. The pipeline is designed to enable adaptation to new datasets. Each task instance ultimately contains three core components: a high-level vague user intent, a complete and clear requirement document, and the corresponding code evaluation artifacts for assessing the generated code.

paragraphs.en: Stage I: Source benchmark curation. Following ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Qiu et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2024 ) , we construct ReqClarifyBench based on existing code generation benchmarks rather than designing tasks from scratch. Existing benchmarks provide high-quality software development scenarios and reliable code evaluation protocols. Building on existing benchmarks allows us to focus on data construction and evaluation design for the requirement clarification stage. Meanwhile, we can reuse their code evaluation protocols to measure the impact of requirement clarification on subsequent implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 I：源基准数据集的整理。 遵循 (Yang et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025b; Qiu et al., 2025; Han et al., 2024) 的研究，我们基于现有的代码生成基准数据集构建 ReqClarifyBench，而不是从头设计任务。 现有的基准数据集提供了高质量的软件开发场景和可靠的代码评估协议。 在现有基准数据集的基础上进行构建，使我们能够专注于需求明确阶段的数据构建和评估设计。 同时，我们可以复用这些基准数据集的代码评估协议，以衡量需求明确对后续实现的影响。

paragraphs.en: For source Benchmark Curation, we consider three main criteria. 1) Real-world Requirements. The tasks and development scenarios should be grounded in real-world requirements, rather than artificially constructed programming problems. 2) Repository-level Complexity. The tasks should target repository-level code generation rather than simple function completion, reflecting the scale and complexity of real-world software development. 3) Behavioral Evaluation. The benchmark should provide reliable behavioral evaluation. We avoid evaluations that heavily rely on unit tests with rigid interface assumptions, as they may penalize functionally correct implementations that do not conform to predefined APIs or code structures.

paragraphs.en: Based on these criteria, we choose GameCraft-Bench ( Luo et al., 2026b ) , MiniAppBench ( zhang et al., 2026 ) , and WebGen-Bench ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , covering game, application, and web development, respectively. These benchmarks span diverse software domains and provide high-quality repository-level tasks. As shown in Figure 3 , they also adopt behavioral evaluation protocols. Specifically, GameCraft-Bench evaluates recorded gameplay videos and frames using a multimodal rubric-based judge; MiniAppBench combines static code analysis with dynamic browser-based evidence collected through Playwright; and WebGen-Bench employs a UI agent to interact with the generated website and evaluates both test-case accuracy and visual appearance. These protocols assess generated software through observable behavior, allowing us to reliably measure the impact of clarification on subsequent phases.

paragraphs.en: Stage II: Requirement Reconstruction and Intent Abstraction. Different benchmarks provide diverse artifacts, including project descriptions, evaluation rubrics, reference code, test cases, etc. To derive a unified requirement representation, we adopt the requirement document as our target format, because structured requirement documents are widely established artifacts in real-world development practices ( Fu et al., ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) . We leverage an LLM to reconstruct structured requirement documents from these artifacts. This process aims to collect implicit requirements distributed across different artifacts and represent them in an explicit requirement format.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段：需求重构与意图抽象。 不同的基准测试提供了多样化的产物，包括项目描述、评估标准、参考代码、测试用例等。 为了推导出统一的需求表示，我们将需求文档作为目标格式，因为结构化的需求文档是现实开发实践中广泛采用的产物（Fu 等人；Zhou 等人，2026a）。 我们利用一个大语言模型，从这些产物中重构出结构化的需求文档。 这一过程旨在收集分布在不同产物中的隐含需求，并将其表示为明确的需求格式。

sents.en: This process aims to collect implicit requirements distributed across different artifacts and represent them in an explicit requirement format.
sents.zh: 这一过程旨在收集分布在不同产物中的隐含需求，并将其表示为明确的需求格式。

paragraphs.en: To improve the reliability of the reconstructed requirements, we further introduce a requirement–artifact traceability mechanism. For each reconstructed requirement, the LLM is required to associate it with the corresponding artifact and record the specific evidence source. This mechanism helps prevent the LLM from introducing unsupported requirements or hallucinated details during reconstruction, while providing explicit evidence for subsequent human validation. After obtaining the detailed requirement documents, we use an LLM to perform intent abstraction. By removing implementation details and preserving core software objectives, we derive high-level user intents that simulate initial user requests in real-world software development scenarios. The high-level user intents serve as the starting point for requirement clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高重构需求的可信度，我们进一步引入了一种需求–工件可追溯性机制。 对于每个重构后的需求，大语言模型需要将其与对应的工件关联起来，并记录具体的证据来源。 该机制有助于防止大语言模型在重构过程中引入缺乏依据的需求或凭空捏造的细节，同时为后续的人工验证提供明确的证据。 获取详细的需求文档后，我们使用大语言模型进行意图抽象。 通过移除实现细节并保留核心软件目标，我们提炼出高层用户意图，这些意图模拟了真实软件开发场景中的初始用户请求。 高层用户意图是需求澄清的起点。

paragraphs.en: Stage III: Human validation. To ensure the reliability of the constructed benchmark, we further conduct human validation. The validation is conducted by two authors. Guided by the requirement quality criteria in ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 ( , 2018 ) , the reconstructed requirement documents are examined for Correctness, Unambiguity, Completeness, and Consistency. Specifically, Correctness assesses whether the requirements accurately capture the intended software functionality and behavior. Unambiguity checks whether each requirement is clearly stated. Completeness examines whether essential functions, constraints, and behaviors are sufficiently covered. Consistency checks for conflicts across requirements. Requirement–artifact traceability facilitates human validation by allowing annotators to inspect the supporting evidence for each requirement. Requirements found to be incorrect, ambiguous, incomplete, or inconsistent are regenerated and then re-validated. After validating the reconstructed requirement documents, we further examine the abstraction validity of the high-level user intents, ensuring that they preserve the core software objectives. Only samples that pass both validation stages are included in ReqClarifyBench .

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 , we formulate requirement clarification as a multi-turn interaction between an LLM and a user. For each ReqClarifyBench task, the LLM initially receives only the user’s high-level intent and proactively asks clarification questions. Based on the interaction history, it decides what to clarify next and when to stop asking questions. It then produces a detailed requirement document based on the information gathered during the interaction. The complete interaction, including the clarification questions, user responses, and the final requirement document, is recorded automatically. These records are used to evaluate the LLM’s ability to produce a complete requirement document through interactive clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 4 所示，我们将需求澄清定义为大型语言模型（LLM）与用户之间的多轮互动。 对于每个 ReqClarifyBench 任务，LLM 最初仅接收用户的高层意图，并主动提出澄清问题。 基于互动历史，它会决定接下来需要澄清什么内容以及何时停止提问。 随后，它会根据互动过程中收集到的信息生成一份详细的需求文档。 完整的互动过程，包括澄清问题、用户回应以及最终的需求文档，都会被自动记录。 这些记录用于评估 LLM 通过互动式澄清生成完整需求文档的能力。

paragraphs.en: Following prior work ( Vijayvargiya et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026c ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Mu et al., 2024 ) , we employ an LLM to act as the user to engage in multi-turn requirement clarification with the evaluated LLM. Compared with involving human users in interactions, an LLM-based simulator enables large-scale reproducible experiments with substantially lower effort and time costs, while approximating basic user behaviors and producing natural responses under controlled settings ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Ni et al., 2026 ; Dou et al., 2025 ) . For each task, the LLM-based user simulator is provided with a human-validated detailed requirement document as the ground-truth requirements and answers the clarification questions accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 基于先前的研究（Vijayvargiya 等人，2026；Zhou 等人，2026c；Jin 等人，2026；Mu 等人，2024），我们采用一个大语言模型（LLM）作为用户，与待评估的大语言模型进行多轮需求澄清。 与让真人用户参与互动相比，基于大语言模型的模拟器能够支持大规模、可重复的实验，且所需精力和时间成本显著更低，同时还能在受控环境中模拟基本用户行为并生成自然的回应（Zhou 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2025；Ni 等人，2026；Dou 等人，2025）。 对于每个任务，基于大语言模型的用户模拟器都会获得一份经人类验证的详细需求文档作为基准需求，并据此回答澄清问题。

paragraphs.en: However, ensuring that the LLM-based user simulator’s responses are consistent with the ground-truth requirements is insufficient to simulate realistic user interactions. Real users differ in how they express their needs, disclose information, and revise their requirements ( Burnay et al., 2014 ; Laporti et al., 2009 ) . To simulate realistic interactions, we introduce representative user personas based on real-world interaction data. Specifically, we build on SWE-chat ( Baumann et al., 2026 ) , a large-scale dataset of multi-turn interactions between real software developers and coding agents. SWE-chat categorizes users into four types: Expert Nitpicker, Vague Requester, Mind Changer , and Other. We adopt the first three personas, which together account for approximately 80% of SWE-chat. To better capture their distinct interaction patterns, we further refine each persona based on corresponding real-world interaction trajectories. Expert Nitpickers provide accurate and detailed responses while keeping their goals stable. Vague Requesters describe their needs in broad terms and leave many details unspecified. Mind Changers revise their requirements as the interaction progresses. These personas are then used to guide the LLM-based user simulator to respond throughout the clarification process, producing more diverse and realistic user interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅确保基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器的响应与真实需求保持一致，还不足以模拟出逼真的用户互动。 真实用户在表达需求、披露信息以及修改要求的方式上存在差异（Burnay 等，2014；Laporti 等，2009）。 为了模拟逼真的互动，我们基于真实世界的互动数据引入了具有代表性的用户角色。 具体来说，我们在 SWE-chat（Baumann 等，2026）的基础上进行构建，该数据集包含真实软件开发人员与编码智能体之间多轮互动的海量数据。 SWE-chat 将用户分为四类：专家型挑剔者、模糊需求提出者、主意反复者和其他类型。 我们采用了前三种用户角色，这三类合计约占 SWE-chat 数据的 80%。 为了更好地捕捉它们各自独特的互动模式，我们还根据对应的真实世界互动轨迹对每个角色进行了进一步细化。 专家型挑剔者会提供准确且详细的回应，同时保持其目标稳定不变。 模糊需求提出者会用宽泛的术语描述自身需求，许多细节则未明确说明。 主意反复者会在互动过程中不断修改自己的要求。 随后，这些用户角色被用于指导基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器在整个澄清过程中作出回应，从而生成更多样化且更逼真的用户互动。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the user simulator exhibits distinct behavioral patterns corresponding to the intended personas, we conduct a blind human evaluation with two annotators. Specifically, the annotators are unaware of the specific persona assigned and independently classify each complete interaction trajectory as Expert Nitpicker , Vague Requester , Mind Changer , or Other . Following ( Castricato et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) , we report the average classification accuracy across annotators relative to the assigned personas, and Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Kohen, 1960 ) for inter-annotator agreement. The resulting accuracy is 95.8% and Cohen’s κ \kappa is 0.892, suggesting that the user simulator exhibits distinct behavioral patterns corresponding to the intended personas.

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-5.6-Sol as the foundation model of user simulator and set its temperature to 0.7 to allow natural variation in simulated responses following prior works ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Nakash et al., 2026 ) . For all evaluated LLMs, we set the temperature to 0.0 to minimize sampling randomness and ensure a fair and stable comparison across models. Similarly, all LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations are conducted with a temperature of 0.0 to improve the consistency of automatic judgments, using DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . Following prior works ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Srinivasan et al., 2026 ) , each requirement clarification session is limited to a maximum of 20 interaction rounds to provide sufficient room for clarification while preventing excessively long interactions. We automatically record the complete interaction history for subsequent analysis and validation. All experimental configurations and parameters will be released together with our source code to facilitate reproducibility and future benchmarking.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 GPT-5.6-Sol 用作用户模拟器的基础模型，并将其温度设为 0.7，以便在遵循先前研究（Jin et al., 2026；Nakash et al., 2026）的基础上，允许模拟响应呈现自然变化。 对于所有评估的 LLM，我们将温度设为 0.0，以最小化采样随机性，并确保模型间比较的公平性和稳定性。 同样地，所有“LLM 作为裁判”的评估均在温度为 0.0 的条件下进行，以提高自动判断的一致性，并使用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek-AI, 2026）。 遵循先前研究（Jin et al., 2026；Srinivasan et al., 2026），每次需求澄清环节最多限制为 20 轮交互，以便在提供足够澄清空间的同时，避免交互过程过长。 我们会自动记录完整的交互历史，用于后续分析与验证。 所有实验配置和参数将与我们的源代码一同发布，以方便复现和未来的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: The choices of models for both the LLM-based user simulator and LLM-as-a-Judge are empirically validated. As described in Section 4.2 , human annotators achieve an average persona classification accuracy of 95.8%, with an inter-annotator Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.892, indicating that the GPT-5.6-Sol-based user simulator exhibits distinct behavioral patterns corresponding to the intended personas. For LLM-as-a-Judge, we compare GPT-5.6-Sol, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 200 manually annotated cases. Their judgments achieve accuracies of 92.5%, 90.0%, and 91.5%, respectively, showing comparable performance on this evaluation task. Given its competitive accuracy and lower inference cost, we select DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as the LLM-as-a-Judge.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 LLM 的用户模拟器和“LLM 作为裁判”模型的选择均经过了经验验证。 如第 4.2 节所述，人类标注员在角色分类任务中的平均准确率为 95.8%，标注员间 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值为 0.892，这表明基于 GPT-5.6-Sol 的用户模拟器展现出与预期角色相对应的独特行为模式。 对于“LLM 作为裁判”部分，我们在 200 个经人工标注的案例上比较了 GPT-5.6-Sol、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的表现。 它们的判断准确率分别为 92.5%、90.0% 和 91.5%，显示出在该评估任务中具有相当的性能。 鉴于其具有竞争力的准确率和更低的推理成本，我们选择 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 作为“LLM 作为裁判”模型。

paragraphs.en: (1) Clarification effectiveness does not necessarily translate into requirement document quality. Different models exhibit inconsistent performance between clarification effectiveness and final requirement document quality. GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the best requirement document quality, with an average BERTScore F1 of 0.774 and an average ReqAlign of 0.727, outperforming the second-best model (Claude Opus 5) by 26.0% in ReqAlign. However, it exhibits the lowest clarification effectiveness, with an average EQR of 0.196 and AvgClarified of 0.650. In contrast, Gemini-3.1-Pro performs best during the clarification process, achieving the highest average EQR of 0.334 and AvgClarified of 1.702 among all models. However, its average ReqAlign is only 0.357, substantially lower than the 0.727 achieved by GPT-5.6-Sol. Therefore, clarification effectiveness and requirement document quality reflect two related but distinct capabilities. Effective clarification helps the model elicit important requirement information, whereas producing a high-quality document further requires the model to correctly understand and integrate the information gathered across multiple turns. This process may further depend on the model’s ability to leverage interaction context, domain knowledge, and reasoning.

paragraphs.en: (2) User personas substantially affect requirement clarification performance. All models perform best under the Expert Nitpicker persona, while both requirement document quality and clarification effectiveness decline noticeably when interacting with Vague Requesters and Mind Changers. For ReqAlign, the average score across the six models is approximately 0.609 under Expert Nitpicker, but decreases to 0.433 and 0.439 under Vague Requester and Mind Changer, respectively. In contrast, BERTScore F1 varies much less, decreasing only from 0.732 under Expert Nitpicker to approximately 0.702 under the other two personas. This suggests that user personas have a particularly pronounced impact on fine-grained requirement alignment. The differences are even more evident in clarification effectiveness. Among the six models, the average EQR is approximately 0.448 under Expert Nitpicker, compared with only 0.177 and 0.208 under Vague Requester and Mind Changer, respectively. AvgClarified similarly decreases from 2.384 to 0.549 and 0.610. These results suggest that LLMs remain highly sensitive to user interaction styles. They perform substantially better when users provide explicit and detailed responses, but degrade noticeably when user feedback is vague or when requirements change during the interaction.

paragraphs.en: (3) Models exhibit different levels of robustness across user personas. In terms of final requirement document quality, GPT-5.6-Sol shows relatively strong robustness to persona changes. Its ReqAlign decreases from 0.842 under Expert Nitpicker to 0.681 and 0.659 under Vague Requester and Mind Changer, retaining approximately 81% and 78% of its performance, respectively. GLM-5.3 also shows a relatively stable trend, with ReqAlign decreasing from 0.618 to 0.471 and 0.474, retaining approximately 76% and 77%. In contrast, Qwen3-235B-A22B is the most sensitive to persona changes, with ReqAlign dropping from 0.424 under Expert Nitpicker to 0.197 and 0.226, retaining only approximately 46% and 53% of its performance. Claude Opus 5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro fall between these two extremes. These results indicate that models differ substantially in their ability to maintain requirement understanding and integration when user feedback becomes less informative or requirements evolve during the interaction.

paragraphs.en: To delve into the behavioral patterns of LLMs during interactive requirement clarification, we further analyze their stopping behavior and clarification dynamics across interaction rounds under different user personas.
paragraphs.zh: 为了深入探究大型语言模型在交互式需求澄清过程中的行为模式，我们进一步分析了其在不同用户角色设定下，各轮交互中的停止行为与澄清动态。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 6 , we further analyze how clarification effectiveness evolves across interaction rounds for different models and user personas. Unlike Section 5.2.1 , which focuses on when models terminate clarification, this analysis investigates how clarification effectiveness changes round by round before termination. Specifically, we compute EQR and AvgClarified at each interaction round. Because tasks terminate at different rounds, the number of active tasks decreases as the interaction progresses, making statistics at very late rounds less representative. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 7 , we investigate the impact of interactive clarification on final requirement document quality by comparing two settings: directly generating requirement documents from initial user intents and generating them after multi-turn requirement clarification.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 7 所示，我们通过比较两种设置来研究交互式澄清对最终需求文档质量的影响：直接从初始用户意图生成需求文档，以及经过多轮需求澄清后再生成需求文档。

paragraphs.en: Overall, all models benefit from requirement clarification, producing more complete and clear requirement documents from vague user intents. Specifically, the average BERTScore F1 across the six models increases from 0.664 to 0.712, with a 7.2% relative improvement. Additionally, the improvement in fine-grained requirement alignment is substantially more pronounced. The average ReqAlign score rises from 0.212 to 0.494 with a relative improvement of 133.1%. This trend is also consistent across different models, with relative improvements ranging from 83.8% (GLM-5.3) to 241.3% (Qwen3-235B-A22B). The substantially larger improvement in ReqAlign suggests that clarification particularly helps models capture fine-grained requirements that are missing from the initial user intent. Notably, GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest ReqAlign both with and without interactive clarification, demonstrating its consistently strong requirement document generation capability across the two settings.

paragraphs.en: To further investigate the impact of requirement clarification on subsequent code generation, we conduct code-generation experiments on the three source benchmarks of ReqClarifyBench : GameCraft-Bench, MiniAppBench, and WebGen-Bench. We follow the original evaluation protocols of each benchmark. We use Codex with GPT-5.6-Sol to generate code under three requirement settings: the initial intent, the directly generated requirement document, and the interactively clarified requirement document. Both types of requirement documents are generated by GPT-5.6-Sol, and scores are averaged across the Expert, Vague, and Mind Changer personas. We compare performance across these settings to assess the effects of requirement documentation and interactive clarification on code generation. Table 5 summarizes the score results across the three benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步研究需求澄清对后续代码生成的影响，我们在 ReqClarifyBench 的三个源基准数据集（GameCraft-Bench、MiniAppBench 和 WebGen-Bench）上进行了代码生成实验。 我们遵循每个基准数据集原有的评估协议。 我们使用 Codex 配合 GPT-5.6-Sol，在三种需求设置下生成代码：初始意图、直接生成的需求文档，以及通过互动澄清后的需求文档。 这两种类型的需求文档均由 GPT-5.6-Sol 生成，得分则在 Expert、Vague 和 Mind Changer 三种角色设定中取平均值。 我们比较这些设置下的性能差异，以评估需求文档化和互动澄清对代码生成的影响。 表 5 总结了三个基准数据集的得分结果。

paragraphs.en: Overall, requirement documentation itself improves code-generation performance, while interactive clarification provides further gains on top of it. Across all three source benchmarks, code-generation performance consistently improves when moving from the initial intent to a directly generated requirement document and then to an interactively clarified requirement document. Even without any additional user feedback, guiding the LLM to first transform the initial intent into a requirement document and then implement based on that document is more effective than generating code directly from the initial intent. The score increases from 0.012 to 0.273 on GameCraft-Bench, from 0.451 to 0.543 on MiniAppBench, and from 0.271 to 0.384 on WebGen-Bench. Furthermore, interactive clarification leads to additional improvements on all three benchmarks. This consistent trend shows that the value of interactive clarification extends beyond improving requirement-document quality. The requirement information clarified through multi-turn interaction can further translate into tangible gains in subsequent code implementation.

paragraphs.en: (1) LLMs should proactively clarify requirements before implementation. In practice, developers often provide high-level and underspecified requests. Rather than proceeding directly to implementation and filling in missing details based on their own assumptions, LLMs should first identify unclear or missing requirements and actively ask developers for clarification. Our study shows that such interactive clarification can elicit additional requirement information that ultimately improves subsequent code-generation performance. This suggests that requirement clarification should be treated as an explicit capability of LLMs, rather than leaving the burden of fully specifying requirements to developers in the initial request.
paragraphs.zh: (1) LLM 应在实施前主动明确需求。 在实践中，开发人员通常会提出层次较高且描述不够具体的请求。 LLM 不应直接开始实施并基于自身假设填补缺失的细节，而应首先识别不明确或缺失的需求，并主动询问开发人员以获取澄清。 我们的研究表明，这种互动式的澄清过程能够引出额外的需求信息，最终提升后续代码生成的性能。 这表明，需求澄清应被视为 LLM 的一项明确能力，而不是将完整描述需求的负担留给开发人员在初始请求中承担。

paragraphs.en: (3) Requirement engineering and code implementation may be better handled by different forms of model systems. We observe that coding-oriented agent harnesses such as Claude Code and Codex ask more effective clarification questions, yet produce lower-quality final requirement documents than their corresponding base models. This suggests that scaffolding designed for code execution may not be equally well suited to requirement-document generation. A more suitable workflow may therefore decouple the requirement and implementation stages. Developers can first use a base model for requirement analysis, integration of clarified information, and final requirement-document generation, and then pass the resulting document to coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code or Codex for repository-level implementation. Such a staged workflow can leverage the respective strengths of base models in requirement documentation and coding-agent harnesses in code execution and software-development tooling, rather than relying on a single agent to handle the entire process from underspecified requests to final implementation.

paragraphs.en: External Validity. A primary threat to external validity is the reliability of user simulation. Real developers vary substantially in how they express requirements, provide information, and revise their needs, and an LLM-based user simulator may not fully capture this diversity. To mitigate this threat, we derive three representative user personas from SWE-chat ( Baumann et al., 2026 ) to guide the LLM-based user simulator. SWE-chat is a large-scale dataset of multi-turn conversations between software developers and coding agents, reflecting diverse interaction behaviors in real-world development settings. We also conduct human validation to verify that the user simulator exhibits distinct behavioral patterns corresponding to the intended personas.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 对外部效度的主要威胁之一是用户模拟的可靠性。 真实开发者在表达需求、提供信息以及修订需求的方式上存在显著差异，而基于 LLM 的用户模拟器可能无法完全捕捉这种多样性。 为缓解这一威胁，我们从 SWE-chat（Baumann et al., 2026）中提炼出三个具有代表性的用户角色，以指导基于 LLM 的用户模拟器。 SWE-chat 是一个大规模数据集，包含软件开发人员与编码智能体之间的多轮对话，反映了真实开发环境中的多样化互动行为。 我们还进行了人类验证，以确认用户模拟器展现出与预期角色相对应的独特行为模式。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. A potential threat to internal validity arises from possible errors in the interaction protocol, prompt design, model configuration, and experimental execution. Such errors may affect the observed clarification behavior or subsequent code-generation evaluation. To reduce this risk, we use a consistent interaction protocol and standardized prompt templates across all evaluated models and settings, and keep the experimental configurations fixed whenever possible. In addition, we have open-sourced our implementation, experimental data, and all prompt templates, enabling external validation and community feedback for continuous improvement.

paragraphs.en: Construct Validity. A primary threat to construct validity is the quality of the ground-truth requirement documents in ReqClarifyBench . To mitigate this threat, two authors manually validate the reconstructed requirement documents by examining their correctness, unambiguity, completeness, and consistency. Requirement–artifact traceability further helps the two validators verify the implementation evidence supporting each requirement. Requirements that fail the validation are regenerated and re-examined. We also validate the abstraction validity of the high-level user intents to ensure that they preserve the core software objectives. Only samples that pass both stages of human validation are included in ReqClarifyBench .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose ReqClarifyBench , the first interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development, which aims to evaluate LLMs’ ability to transform vague user intents into clear and complete requirement documents through multi-turn interactions. To better simulate realistic interactions, we further employ LLM-based user simulators with three representative personas. Based on ReqClarifyBench , we conduct a systematic empirical study. The results reveal that clarification effectiveness does not necessarily lead to high-quality requirement documents, and that model performance varies substantially across different user interaction styles. We also find that coding-agent harnesses do not further enhance the quality of derived requirement documents. These findings offer practical implications for developers using LLMs for software development. More broadly, our work highlights that software development agents’ autonomy should encompass understanding user intent through proactive interaction and aligning development goals accordingly. This offers a user-centered perspective on the design and evaluation of future autonomous development systems.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ReqClarifyBench——首个面向仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）通过多轮交互将模糊的用户意图转化为清晰完整的需求文档的能力。 为了更好地模拟真实交互场景，我们还采用了基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器，并设计了三种典型的人物设定。 基于 ReqClarifyBench，我们开展了一项系统性的实证研究。 研究结果表明，需求澄清的有效性并不必然带来高质量的需求文档，且模型性能在不同用户交互风格下存在显著差异。 我们还发现，编码智能体工具链并未进一步提升所生成需求文档的质量。 这些发现为使用大型语言模型进行软件开发的开发者提供了实践指导意义。 更广泛地说，我们的工作强调，软件开发智能体的自主性应包含通过主动交互理解用户意图，并据此调整开发目标。 这为未来自主开发系统的设计与评估提供了一种以用户为中心的观点。

sents.en: In this paper, we propose ReqClarifyBench , the first interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development, which aims to evaluate LLMs’ ability to transform vague user intents into clear and complete requirement documents through multi-turn interactions.
sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ReqClarifyBench——首个面向仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）通过多轮交互将模糊的用户意图转化为清晰完整的需求文档的能力。

sents.en: To better simulate realistic interactions, we further employ LLM-based user simulators with three representative personas.
sents.zh: 为了更好地模拟真实交互场景，我们还采用了基于大型语言模型的用户模拟器，并设计了三种典型的人物设定。

sents.en: Based on ReqClarifyBench , we conduct a systematic empirical study.
sents.zh: 基于 ReqClarifyBench，我们开展了一项系统性的实证研究。

sents.en: The results reveal that clarification effectiveness does not necessarily lead to high-quality requirement documents, and that model performance varies substantially across different user interaction styles.
sents.zh: 研究结果表明，需求澄清的有效性并不必然带来高质量的需求文档，且模型性能在不同用户交互风格下存在显著差异。

sents.en: We also find that coding-agent harnesses do not further enhance the quality of derived requirement documents.
sents.zh: 我们还发现，编码智能体工具链并未进一步提升所生成需求文档的质量。

sents.en: These findings offer practical implications for developers using LLMs for software development.
sents.zh: 这些发现为使用大型语言模型进行软件开发的开发者提供了实践指导意义。

sents.en: More broadly, our work highlights that software development agents’ autonomy should encompass understanding user intent through proactive interaction and aligning development goals accordingly.
sents.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的工作强调，软件开发智能体的自主性应包含通过主动交互理解用户意图，并据此调整开发目标。

sents.en: This offers a user-centered perspective on the design and evaluation of future autonomous development systems.
sents.zh: 这为未来自主开发系统的设计与评估提供了一种以用户为中心的观点。
